在上周2027年赛历公布后，摩纳哥将于明年首次举办冲刺赛周末；请在天空体育 F1观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛周四的练习赛，时间为上午9:30和下午1:00，直播。
在摩纳哥大奖赛明年将举办冲刺赛的消息公布后，F1车手们分享了各自的看法
刘易斯·汉密尔顿与乔治·拉塞尔在摩纳哥大奖赛于2027年改为冲刺赛周末一事上意见不一。
上周，Formula 1公布了2027年赛历，并透露冲刺赛事的数量将从六场增加到十场，摩纳哥将采用替代赛制，即周五增加一场排位赛，周六进行100公里冲刺赛。
摩纳哥是最难超车的赛道之一，但F1强调了增加两场排位赛的前景，称这是“车手们在蒙特卡洛狭窄街道上展示世界级技巧与精准度”的额外机会。

“这对我来说毫无意义，但显然不是我做决定，”汉密尔顿说道，他希望在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上争夺胜利。
“积极的一面是，我们多了一场排位赛，这很酷。但我一直说摩纳哥需要一些不同的东西。我不认为它应该采用其他地方一样的比赛模式。它需要与众不同。
“我们已经引入了冲刺赛，我认为它们确实为这项运动带来了新东西。但我认为我们必须为像摩纳哥这样的地方想出一些新东西，因为那是个美丽的地方，如此美丽的国家，驾驶起来是不可思议的赛道，但比赛却乏味至极。我不知道那是什么，但我会说冲刺赛不是答案。”

然而，汉密尔顿的前梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔在巴库的FIA新闻发布会上早些时候发言时给出了相反的观点。

阿塞拜疆大奖赛：马克斯·维斯塔潘在充满挑战的最后练习赛中最快，超越乔治·拉塞尔和梅赛德斯，进入排位赛
“我个人认为这很好，因为我们已经举办冲刺赛相当一段时间了，正常的比赛周末感觉相当冗长，我们都想战斗，”拉塞尔说道。
“驾驶F1赛车在赛道上飞驰固然有趣，但乐趣来自竞争以及排位赛带给你的肾上腺素。
“当然，正赛不会是最激动人心的，但这将通过更激动人心的周五来弥补。冲刺排位赛比FP2精彩得多，所以我认为总体上是合理的。”
维斯塔潘：我不在乎冲刺赛在哪里
马克斯·维斯塔潘过去一直是冲刺赛周末的强烈批评者，他在2023年表示，如果F1在赛历中增加更多冲刺赛，他“不会待太久”。
维斯塔潘近年来发声较少，并表示他已向F1主席斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利明确表达了自己的感受。
他说：“也许摩纳哥想要它[冲刺赛]，我不知道。对我来说，老实说我不在乎冲刺赛在哪里。我参与其中，当然你会尽力做到最好。
“我对赢得冲刺赛或没赢没有情感依附。我的专注始终是，从我小时候起，你就期待大奖赛。”
克雷格·斯莱特探讨2027年F1赛季赛历的主要话题，包括摩纳哥首次举办冲刺赛
凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯透露，他是通过车手WhatsApp群得知摩纳哥的消息的，并称群里“有点热闹”。
“摩纳哥，我认为你只是让它变得更多变一点，说实话。我认为过去几年它只是周六的活动。周六发生的一切基本上就结束了，”他补充道。
“我认为现在它可以稍微打乱一下局面。我认为这将是一个有趣的周末。我肯定很期待。”
兰多·诺里斯对摩纳哥大奖赛将在2027年举办冲刺赛的消息做出反应。
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯认为，车迷应该对冲刺赛周末及其举办地点有发言权。
“如果车迷们有更好的体验，那我就开心，”这位迈凯伦车手说道
detailEn: F1 drivers split over whether Monaco Sprint 'makes sense' after 2027 calendar announcement

Monaco will host a Sprint weekend for the first time next year after the 2027 calendar was announced last week; watch Thursday's practice sessions for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix at 9.30am and 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1
F1 drivers share their opinions following the announcement that the Monaco Grand Prix will get a Sprint race next year
Lewis Hamilton and George Russell disagree on the Monaco Grand Prix becoming a Sprint weekend in 2027.

Last week, Formula 1 announced its 2027 calendar and revealed there will be an increase in the number of Sprint events from six to 10, with Monaco holding the alternative format that sees an extra qualifying session on Friday before a 100km Sprint on Saturday.

Monaco is one of the most difficult tracks to overtake at, but F1 highlighted the prospect of two qualifying sessions as an additional chance for "the drivers to show their world-class skill and precision on the narrow streets of Monte Carlo".

"It makes no sense to me but I'm not making the decisions obviously," said Hamilton, who is hoping to fight for the win at this week's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

"On the positive, we get another qualifying session, which is quite cool. But I've always said that Monaco needs something different. I don't think it should be the same race formula that's everywhere else. It needs to be something different.

"We've already included the Sprints, which I think have really brought something new to the sport. But I think we've got to come up with something new for somewhere like that because it's a beautiful place, such a beautiful country, an incredible circuit to drive, but the race is as dull as it gets. I don't know what that is, but a Sprint race is not the answer for it I would say."
Craig Slater explains why Monaco has been chosen as a Sprint venue for the 2027 F1 season
However, Hamilton's former Mercedes team-mate Russell gave a contrary view when speaking earlier in the FIA press conference in Baku.

"I personally think it's good because we've had Sprints for quite a while, normal race weekends feel quite long-winded and we all want to fight," said Russell.
"As much fun as driving a Formula 1 car around the track is, the enjoyment comes from the competition and that adrenaline you get from a qualifying session.

"Of course the race isn't going to be the most exciting one, but that will be compensated by having a more exciting Friday. Sprint Qualifying is way more exciting than FP2, so I think on the whole it makes sense."
Verstappen: I don't care where the Sprints are
Max Verstappen has been a strong critic of Sprint weekends in the past, stating in 2023 that he "won't be around for too long" if F1 added more to the calendar.
Verstappen has been less vocal in recent years and says he's made his feelings clear to F1 boss Stefano Domenicali.
He said: "Maybe Monaco wanted it [the Sprint], I don't know. For me, I honestly don't care where the Sprints are. I participate, and of course you try to do the best you can.
"I have no emotion attached to winning a Sprint race or not winning it. My focus is always from, when I was a kid, you look forward to the Grand Prix."
Craig Slater takes a look at the big talking points from the 2027 F1 season calendar, including a Sprint taking place in Monaco for the first time
Cadillac's Sergio Perez revealed he discovered the Monaco news through the drivers' WhatsApp group and said it was "a bit busy".
"Monaco, I think you just make it a little bit more variable, to be honest. I think it was just a Saturday event in the last few years. Whatever happened on Saturday was basically done," he added.
"I think right now it can mix things around a little bit more. I think it's going to be an interesting weekend. I'm definitely looking forward to it."
Lando Norris reacts to the news that the Monaco Grand Prix will be a Sprint in 2027.
Reigning world champion Lando Norris believes fans should have a say on Sprint weekends and where they take place.
"If the fans have a better time then I'm happy," the McLaren driver said

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".

More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

埃斯特班·奥康将不再参加墨西哥城大奖赛余下环节，哈斯由平川亮接替这位法国车手；哈斯未说明换下奥康的原因；奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队
埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
